descripcion: Kirby Land and Cattle proudly offers premium, locally-raised beef and pork from our Oklahoma ranch. Our beef and pork is expertly crafted, with a focus on quality and flavor. We ensure that each cut meets the highest standards. Available for local pickup and delivery, our products are perfect for those who value freshness, sustainability, and supporting local agriculture. We also accept EBT/Snap benefits to ensure everyone in our community has access to quality meat products.
